tabletop.prompt: Create one polished game asset: a single small tabletop hookah based closely on the owner's attached reference photo. Preserve its compact traditional silhouette: squat cobalt-blue vertically ribbed glass water base, short warm gold/brass stem with two rounded bulges and wider lower collar, shallow wide round gold ash tray, navy-blue ceramic bowl with a visibly narrow neck above the tray, one dark blue corrugated hose with subtle gold winding and honey-colored turned wooden rigid handle. Match the owner's specific model and its proportions; do not redesign it as a tall modern pipe. Render it as painterly pixel-art-inspired Japanese narrative game background object, clean controlled pixels and soft painted highlights, legible silhouette, understated slight patina from being a well-kept hand-me-down, not photorealistic, no text, no logos, no labels, no UI. Transparent background, object isolated with generous transparent margin, entire base, tray, bowl and hose visible, three-quarter view with gentle downward angle, warm neutral light. This is an idle unlit object, NOT in use: ceramic bowl installed but no coals, no smoke, no HMD, no flame. Correct assembly from bottom to top: blue glass base -> short gold stem -> gold tray -> narrow-necked blue ceramic bowl. Water only in the bottom part of the glass base, do not turn the stem into a water tank. Exactly ONE flexible hose connected visibly to ONE side hose port just above the base. Distinct small purge valve on the opposite side, hose never connects to the purge valve. Hose curves naturally down and coils once compactly around the base with no branching, no break, no third end, then connects to the base of the wooden rigid handle resting diagonally in front. Do not reproduce the confusing double handle appearance of the source photo; show only one handle at the free end and one secure metal hose connector at the body. Trace the one continuous hose route correctly. No person or stand or floor or props. Focus on an attractive small blue and gold tabletop model readable in a small in-game room.

tournament.prompt: Create ONE polished game object asset, a tall traditional SILVER hookah used as the tournament official model. Use the owner's latest attached REAL PHOTO of the tall silver hookah as the shape reference. The other recent image, a short blue/gold hookah, is ONLY a visual style reference; do not mix its shapes into this model. Preserve the photo's tall slender segmented polished silver stem with several characteristic rounded bulb joints and narrow waists, a broad shallow circular silver ash tray near the top, a small tapered bare metal bowl connector above the tray, a side hose port angled upward just above the glass neck on the right, and a separate SMALL purge valve on the left. Use a tall flared clear glass base with a stable round foot, narrow black neck bands and thin gold rings, a gold connected oval decorative band around the upper body with small simplified ancient Egyptian inspired medallions. Remove ALL real brand labels, all lettering and logos, including the neck label. Keep the photo's recognisable proportions and silver/gold/black/clear palette. This is a stored idle clean unlit model exactly as in the reference: NO tobacco bowl, NO HMD, NO coals, NO hose attached, NO smoke, NO flames. The bare connector above the tray must remain small and slender, not a bowl or mushroom or wide cap. Do not add a hose since the reference is a disassembled display state. Render in the same painterly pixel-art-inspired Japanese narrative game style as the recent generated small blue/gold hookah: crisp controlled pixels, painterly reflective metal highlights, attractive game sprite with clear silhouette, not a photo or 3D render. Transparent background, entire object from top connector to foot visible with ample transparent margin. Straight standing vertical object in subtle three-quarter view with gentle downward camera angle, warm neutral light. No floor, pedestal, scenery, people, captions, UI, watermark or extra objects. Glass is empty and transparent with visible downstem; no water inside metal stem. Single physically plausible central axis: base -> silver stem -> tray -> small bare connector. Do not invent extra pipe branches.
